About the Centre

A Journey Rooted
in Authentic Tradition

Sanidhya Yoga & Wellness is more than a yoga studio — it is a living, breathing space where ancient wisdom meets modern healing. Founded by Guru Arjun Vyas, who trained at the foothills of the Himalayas for over a decade, the centre brings authentic yogic teachings to every doorstep.

Whether you are 8 or 80, a complete beginner or a seasoned practitioner, our classes are lovingly tailored to meet you exactly where you are. No judgement. No comparison. Only growth.

🕉 Hatha Yoga 🌬 Pranayama 🧘 Meditation 🌿 Ayurveda 🔥 Ashtanga ✨ Kundalini 🌙 Yin Yoga 👶 Prenatal
Our Programs

A Class for Every Soul

From playful kids' yoga to gentle senior flows — every program is thoughtfully designed with love, expertise, and a deep understanding of every body's unique journey.

Ages 5 – 12
Little Yogis
Playful, story-based yoga that builds focus, flexibility, and confidence in little ones through games, breathing exercises, and fun poses.
⏱ 45 min 👥 Max 12 kids 📅 Sat & Sun
Ages 13 – 25 · Gen Z
Power Flow
High-energy vinyasa flow designed for the modern young mind — stress relief, better posture, mental clarity, and serious strength building.
⏱ 60 min 💪 All Levels 📅 Mon-Fri
Ages 25 – 50 · Adults
Balanced Life
The perfect blend of active asana, breathwork, and mindfulness — crafted for the working adult managing stress, back pain, and a busy schedule.
⏱ 75 min 🌿 Beginner OK 📅 Daily
Ages 55+ · Senior
Golden Yoga
Gentle, chair-assisted and supported yoga for older adults. Improves joint mobility, balance, circulation, and brings peace to the golden years.
⏱ 60 min 🪑 Chair Option 📅 Every Day
Expecting Mothers
Prenatal Bliss
A nurturing, safe yoga practice for all trimesters. Relieves pregnancy discomfort, prepares the body for birth, and cultivates deep calm for mother and child.
⏱ 60 min 🤰 All Trimesters 📅 Tue, Thu, Sat
All Ages
Deep Silence
Pure meditation and pranayama. No acrobatics — just breathwork, visualization, mantra, and the profound stillness that restores the nervous system completely.
⏱ 45 min 🧘 All Welcome 📅 Daily 6am
Why Yoga

What Yoga
Does for You

Thousands of years of human wisdom — now validated by modern science. Yoga is not a trend. It is the most complete system for human health ever created, addressing body, mind, and spirit simultaneously.

🫁
Breathing & Lung Capacity
Pranayama techniques strengthen respiratory muscles and dramatically increase oxygen efficiency, benefiting everyone from asthma patients to athletes.
🧠
Mental Clarity & Focus
Regular practice reduces cortisol levels, improves memory, sharpens concentration, and builds the kind of mental resilience that no pill can replicate.
💪
Strength & Flexibility
Yoga builds long, functional muscle strength while simultaneously improving joint mobility — no gym required, no risk of injury from overloading.
❤️
Heart Health
Proven to lower blood pressure, reduce resting heart rate, and improve cardiovascular efficiency. The heart loves yoga — and it shows within weeks.
😴
Deep, Restful Sleep
Evening yoga and relaxation techniques activate the parasympathetic nervous system, leading to faster sleep onset and significantly deeper rest cycles.
🌟
Emotional Wellbeing
The combination of movement, breath, and mindful awareness builds emotional intelligence, reduces anxiety, and cultivates a lasting sense of inner peace.
